canonical_title: Bank angle response to roll commands

versions.title_at_revision: Bank angle response to roll commands
versions.text:
Standard: The air vehicle's bank angle response to roll inputs is no worse than Level 2 as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Bank Angle Response to Roll Commands paragraph, unless pilot evaluation determines the air vehicle handling qualities are no worse than Level 2. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis and simulation to assess the air vehicle's bank angle response as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Bank Angle Response to Roll Commands paragraph for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess the air vehicle's bank angle response as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Bank Angle Response to Roll Commands paragraph for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess the air vehicle's bank angle response as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Bank Angle Response to Roll Commands paragraph for selected combinations of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions.
